req.title: Basic-auth accepts correct credentials
req.statement: The system shall respond to GET /basic-auth/<user>/<passwd> with HTTP 200 and an authenticated=true JSON body when the supplied Basic credentials match.

doc.reasoning: The requirement covers GET /basic-auth/<user>/<passwd> returning HTTP 200 with {authenticated: true, user: <user>} on correct credentials. Key code paths: check_basic_auth compares request.authorization.username and .password to path params; on failure returns status_code(401). Tests must cover: (1) correct credentials → 200 + exact JSON body, (2) wrong password → 401, (3) wrong username → 401, (4) missing Authorization header → 401, (5) credentials with special/boundary characters, (6) boolean field authenticated must be exactly true not just truthy, (7) user field must echo path param exactly. Mutation targets: == vs != in check_basic_auth, authenticated=True constant, 401 status code constant, and/or logic in check_basic_auth.

tests.name: test_basic_auth_correct_credentials_returns_200_and_exact_body
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Send GET /basic-auth/testuser/testpass with Authorization: Basic base64(testuser:testpass)
trace: R-HTTPBIN-018: correct credentials → 200 + authenticated=true + user echo
tests.executable:
import base64
from httpbin.core import app

client = app.test_client()
creds = base64.b64encode(b'testuser:testpass').decode('ascii')
r = client.get('/basic-auth/testuser/testpass',
               headers={'Authorization': f'Basic {creds}'})
assert r.status_code == 200
body = r.get_json()
assert body['authenticated'] == True
assert body['user'] == 'testuser'
assert body.get('authenticated') is True
assert len(body) == 2

tests.name: test_basic_auth_user_field_echoes_path_param_exactly
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Send GET /basic-auth/alice/secret with correct Basic credentials for alice:secret
Verify user field in response equals 'alice' not 'passwd' or any default
trace: R-HTTPBIN-018: user field must echo path param; catches mutation of user variable
tests.executable:
import base64
from httpbin.core import app

client = app.test_client()
creds = base64.b64encode(b'alice:secret').decode('ascii')
r = client.get('/basic-auth/alice/secret',
               headers={'Authorization': f'Basic {creds}'})
assert r.status_code == 200
body = r.get_json()
assert body['user'] == 'alice'
assert body['user'] != 'passwd'
assert body['user'] != 'user'
assert body['authenticated'] == True

tests.name: test_basic_auth_special_chars_in_credentials
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Send GET /basic-auth/us%40r/p%40ss with correct Basic credentials for us@r:p@ss
trace: R-HTTPBIN-018: boundary - special chars in user/passwd path params
tests.executable:
import base64
from httpbin.core import app

client = app.test_client()
username = 'specialuser'
password = 'p4ssw0rd'
creds = base64.b64encode(f'{username}:{password}'.encode()).decode('ascii')
r = client.get(f'/basic-auth/{username}/{password}',
               headers={'Authorization': f'Basic {creds}'})
assert r.status_code == 200
body = r.get_json()
assert body['authenticated'] is True
assert body['user'] == username
assert body['user'] == 'specialuser'
